writing.sample_en:
【参考范文 · 168 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. Unlike the rigid routine of high school, the campus offers a wide range of courses, clubs and internships that allow us to test different interests and gradually discover where our true passion lies.
Take my own case as an example. When I entered university, I was convinced that I would become an accountant, simply because my parents thought it was stable. However, after joining a campus debate club and taking an elective in journalism, I realized how much I enjoyed writing and public speaking. That single semester of trying new things completely reshaped my plan, and I eventually switched my major to communication.
In my view, such freedom to experiment is exactly what makes college so valuable. Instead of clinging to a fixed idea, students should seize every chance to explore, because it is only through trial and error that we can truly find the path that suits us best.

cloze.title: 2024年12月·第3套 英语六级完形填空（选词填空） · 26–35 题答案与解析

passages.en: About 23% of the global population lives in absolute poverty. In developing countries there is a low life expectancy, a high infant __(26)__ rate, high levels of unemployment and illiteracy, nutritional levels below acceptable standards and widespread disease with very little or poor quality medical assistance. Others live __(27)__ wealthy and luxurious lives and so the wealth is distributed in a very __(28)__ manner. These are the central problems to questions of charity though charity also includes many other areas such as assisting the elderly.
passages.zh: 全球约有23%的人口生活在极端贫困中。在发展中国家，人均预期寿命较低，婴儿死亡率较高，失业率和文盲率居高不下，营养水平低于可接受标准，疾病广泛存在，而医疗援助又极少或质量低下。另一些人则过着极其富裕奢华的生活，因此财富分配极不均衡。这些是慈善问题的核心所在，不过慈善还包括许多其他领域，例如帮助老年人。

passages.en: We all __(29)__ when very rich people pledge to give away most of their billions, but they are usually left with millions to pass on, still much more than most people would expect to earn in their lifetime. Even comparatively __(30)__ salaries in the west are very high when compared globally. Someone on £ 20,000 could easily afford to give away £ 2,000 per year and still have plenty to live on plus some luxuries.
passages.zh: 当非常富有的人承诺捐出自己数十亿财富中的大部分时，我们都会为之喝彩，但他们通常仍会留下数百万，供自己传给后代，这笔钱依然远远超过大多数人一生所能期望挣到的收入。即使是西方国家相对适中的工资，从全球范围来看也非常高。年收入2万英镑的人完全可以每年捐出2000英镑，同时仍有充足的钱维持生活并享受一些奢侈品。

passages.en: Most people agree that giving to charity is morally __(31)__ but charitable behaviour tends to be regarded as above and beyond the call of duty. Some argue, however, that charitable behaviour is morally required. This means that to fail to behave charitably would be wrong. The majority of arguments in this vein refer to giving aid to poorer nations but they may also refer to giving time within one's __(32)__ community. Arguments tend to place different requirements on people in different income brackets and __(33)__ entirely people who are merely making ends meet. Some argue that people should all contribute a certain percentage of their earnings. I will __(34)__ together all those arguments that place a moral requirement on people to give to charity, despite the fact that there is wide disagreement as to the __(35)__ of that moral requirement.
passages.zh: 大多数人都认为捐助慈善事业在道德上值得称赞，但慈善行为通常被视为超出职责要求的行为。然而，有些人认为，慈善行为是道德上的义务。这意味着，不以慈善的方式行事就是错误的。这类观点中的大多数论证都涉及向较贫穷国家提供援助，但也可能涉及在个人所在的社区中贡献时间。这些论证往往对不同收入阶层的人提出不同要求，并完全排除那些仅仅能够维持生计的人。有些人认为，每个人都应捐出收入的一定比例。我将把所有认为人们在道德上有义务捐助慈善事业的论证归为一组，尽管人们对于这种道德义务的具体程度存在广泛分歧。

wordbank.gloss: 等级制的；按等级排列的

rows.text: J) mortality名词
形容词后的名词中心词
高频固定搭配——婴儿死亡率 infant mortality rate 是描述发展中国家健康指标的标准术语，意为'婴儿死亡率'。它与前文a low life expectancy（低预期寿命）并列，共同刻画发展中国家的医疗卫生困境，语义完全自洽。
B)casualtycasualty 主指事故伤亡，不与 rate 常配 casualty 多用于战争/事故场景（如交通事故伤亡），与婴儿在出生/成长阶段的死亡话题不匹配；且 infant casualty rate 不是固定术语，正确的固定术语是 infant mortality rate。
H) incredibly副词
修饰形容词的空——副词
修饰程度——极其富裕奢华 上下文要表达富人'极其富裕奢华'的生活，与下句still much more than most people would expect to earn in their lifetime的'远超普通人想象'相呼应，需要一个程度副词来强化形容词，incredibly（极其、难以置信地）正是程度修饰。
N)sceptically态度副词不可修饰程度 sceptically 表'怀疑地'，是表说话/看待事物的态度副词，无法修饰 wealthy/luxurious 这种性质形容词；说'怀疑地富有'语义不通。
O) unequal形容词
限定词 a + 空 + 名词 manner——形容词
贫富悬殊——不平等的分配方式 前文About 23% of the global population lives in absolute poverty.与本句Others live __(27)__ wealthy and luxurious lives共同刻画极端贫富对比，得出'财富分配极不平等'的结论；unequal'不平等的'最直接命中此语义。

F)hierarchical义近但侧重'等级'而非'不均' hierarchical 强调按层级/等级排列，描述组织结构（如公司、社会阶层）；财富'分配方式'用'等级制的'不如'不平等的'贴切，且本段语境强调'贫富两极'而非'层级'。 G)immediate'立刻的'与分配方式不搭 immediate 表'立刻、直接'，与财富分配的'公平/不公平'话题无关，搭配 manner 也不形成有意义短语。 I)moderate感情色彩反向 moderate 表'适中、温和'，与上文'富人极奢、穷人绝对贫困'的强烈对比语义相反，方向错误。 K)overt强调'公开/明显'而非'不公' overt 只表示是否公开，不评价分配公正与否；语义与贫富悬殊话题不对齐。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 F) —— hierarchical 蒙混'分层分配'。看到wealth is distributed in a very __(28)__ manner很容易因为'分配'联想到'层级'而选hierarchical。防坑：看上一句的对比方向——'极穷 vs 极富'要的是'不公平'，是 unequal，不是描述层级结构的 hierarchical。
A) applaud动词
主语后缺谓语——动词
对捐赠之举的正向反应——称赞 上下文是'当富豪承诺捐出大部分财产时，我们都会 ___'，普通人对慷慨捐赠的自然反应是赞许；下半句but they are usually left with millions to pass on用 but 转折，暗示前半句是正面态度，applaud（称赞、鼓掌）恰好提供这种正面反应。

C)exclude及物动词缺宾语且语义不符 exclude 意为'排除'，需要宾语（exclude sb./sth.），本空后直接接 when 从句没有宾语；且'我们排除（什么）当富人捐款时'语义完全不通。 E)group动词义不搭对象 group 作动词表'归类、聚集'，同样需要宾语，且'我们归类当富人捐款时'语义荒谬，与上下文的'反应'语义不契合。 M)probe调查义与情感反应不符 probe 意为'探查、深入调查'，常用于侦查/科研语境；这里要表达普通人对富豪行为的即时情绪反应，不需要也不可能是'调查'。
I) moderate形容词
comparatively + 空 + 名词 salaries——形容词
相对中等的工资仍属全球高位 本句逻辑是'即使西方相对___的工资全球比较仍很高'，用 even 让步：空位的形容词应表'不算高、中等'的程度。moderate 表'适中、中等'恰好与后面 are very high when compared globally 的让步形成对照——西方人觉得普通，全球看仍高。
F)hierarchical'等级制的'不评价工资高低 hierarchical 形容结构，不形容工资数额，与'相对'这个程度副词也搭不上。 G)immediate'即时/直接的'不评价工资数额 immediate 描述时间或空间近距离，与工资数额的高低无关；'相对即时的工资'语义不通。 K)overt'公开的'非数额评价词 overt 强调'公开/明显'，与工资'高低/多少'话题无关。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 F) —— 把 even 让步读反。Even comparatively __(30)__ salaries in the west are very high里 even 是让步：'即使相对___的工资也很高'。读快了容易往'高'方向选词，从而被hierarchical或别的形容词迷惑。防坑：even ... still/very + 强 → 前面是弱（中等/适中），选moderate。
L) praiseworthy形容词
系动词 is + morally + 空——形容词作表语
道德褒义——值得称赞 morally praiseworthy 意为'道德上值得称赞'，正好对应'多数人认为捐款值得称许'。下文 but 转折说charitable behaviour tends to be regarded as above and beyond the call of duty（被视为超出本分），这种'分外的善举'恰是 praiseworthy 而非 required。

F)hierarchical'等级制的'与道德评价不挂钩 hierarchical 描述结构等级，无法被 morally 修饰，'道德上等级制'语义不通。 G)immediate'立刻的'与道德评价不在同一维度 immediate 表时间/空间近，不是道德褒贬词，'道德上立刻的'语义不成立。 I)moderate'适中的'非道德评价词 moderate 描述程度适中，与'值得称赞'相去甚远，不构成对慈善的道德评价。 K)overt'公开的'非道德属性 overt 强调'公开、明显'，无道德褒贬色彩，'道德上公开'不通。 O)unequal'不平等的'反向语义 unequal 是负面评价词，且通常修饰资源/机会分布；评价捐款本身'道德不平等'语义不通且方向相反。
G) immediate形容词
形容词性物主代词 one's + 空 + 名词 community——形容词作定语
固定搭配——身边/直系的社区 immediate community 是常见搭配，意为'身边的、直接所在的社区'，与上文giving aid to poorer nations（对外远方的援助）相对，构成'远（poorer nations）vs 近（immediate community）'的对照。immediate 在这里取'紧邻、直接的'义。
F)hierarchical等级制的社区与捐时间无关 hierarchical community 强调社区按等级排列，与'在身边社区内贡献时间'毫无关联，方向跑偏。 K)overt'公开的社区'语义空洞 overt community 不是常见搭配，'公开的社区'也不切合'就近行善'的语境；命题点是远近对照，不是公开与否。
C) exclude动词
并列连词 and 后缺谓语——动词
把'仅能维持生计者'整体排除在外 句意是'各种论点对不同收入档提出不同要求，并把仅能维持生计的人完全 ___'。entirely（完全地）+ people who are merely making ends meet（仅能维持生计的人）暗示这一群人被'排除'在道德要求之外——经济上自顾不暇，自然不被要求捐款。exclude entirely 是常见搭配。
E)group'归类'与 entirely 矛盾 group 作动词表'把……归为一类'，但'完全地归类他们'语义不通，且对'仅能维持生计的人'怎么归类与整句逻辑（区别对待不同收入者）不对接。 M)probe'调查'与道德要求语境无关 probe 是'探查、调查'，与本段讨论'谁该被要求捐款'的道德分配话题无关；'完全调查他们'也不构成与前句的逻辑延伸。
E) group动词
情态动词 will + 空——动词原形
把众多论点'归在一起'——group together group together 是固定搭配，意为'把……归为一组、合在一起'。本句意为'我将把所有把道德要求加在人们头上的论点归为一组'，对应作者要做的概括综合工作。与上文'尽管在程度上分歧很大'呼应：先归类再综合讨论。
M)probeprobe 与 together 不形成固定搭配 probe together 不是常见搭配；probe 多用于'深入调查（具体事件）'，与'把多种论点归在一起综合讨论'语义不合。
D) extent名词
the + 空 + of——名词作 of 短语中心词

争议的是'程度/范围' 上文Arguments tend to place different requirements on people in different income brackets显示各派对'要捐多少、捐到什么程度'分歧很大；the extent of that moral requirement 即'这一道德要求的程度'，正切合 wide disagreement 的对象——多大程度上必须捐、捐多少。

E)group'群组'与'道德要求'不构成 of 搭配 the group of that moral requirement 不是合法表达，group 在此语义下指人/事物的集合，与抽象的'道德要求的程度'不沾边。 M)probe'调查'与'分歧的对象'不匹配 probe 作名词指'调查、探究'，the probe of that moral requirement 是'对该道德要求的调查'，但句意是'对该要求的___存在广泛分歧'——分歧的对象应是要求的'程度'，而不是某次调查。

longreading.title: 2024年12月·第3套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) Trade is one of the policy areas where the hostility that exists between populists(民粹主义者) and classical liberals is most visible. Free-traders point to the undeniable good that tariff-free trade has done for consumers across the world and to the observable alleviation of poverty in corners of the world where previously closed markets have been opened up. Protectionists point to the domestic producers who've paid the price for this globalized economy in the form of lost livelihoods and hollowed-out communities.
passages.zh: 贸易是民粹主义者与古典自由主义者之间的敌意表现得最为明显的政策领域之一。自由贸易主义者指出，免关税贸易为世界各地的消费者带来了不可否认的益处，也指出那些曾经封闭的市场开放后，世界上一些地区的贫困得到了明显缓解。保护主义者则指出，在这个全球化经济中，国内生产者以失去生计、社区日渐衰败为代价，承担了这一切。

passages.en: B) The ongoing conservative civil war often degenerates into content-free tribal warfare, but trade is a rare exception. There are substantial, thought-out policy proposals on both sides of the argument.
passages.zh: 持续不断的保守派内战常常堕落为毫无实质内容的部落战争，但贸易是一个罕见的例外。争论双方都有重大且经过深思熟虑的政策主张。

passages.en: C) Consequently, trade as a topic of discussion provides an opportunity for liberals and populists to have a real meeting of minds. Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area, as opposed to the familiar ritual we've become accustomed to of condemnation met with counter-condemnation.
passages.zh: 因此，贸易这一讨论主题为自由主义者与民粹主义者提供了真正达成共识的机会。在这一领域，富有成效的辩论确实可能发生，而不是像我们已经习惯的那种，以谴责回应谴责的熟悉仪式。

passages.en: D) Strange as it might sound, the problem with trade in the modern world isn't a matter of dollars and cents. It's a matter of false consciousness. This observation is bound to set Marxist alarm bells ringing in the minds of some readers, but it was first made by Alexis de Tocqueville in 1840.
passages.zh: 听起来或许很奇怪，现代世界的贸易问题并不在于金钱和金钱的数量，而在于虚假意识。这一观察必然会让一些读者心中的马克思主义警钟响起，但它最早是由亚历 Alexis de Tocqueville 于1840年提出的。

passages.en: E) Tracking the economic development of mankind from primitive to modern societies, Tocqueville observed a paradox unfolding over the centuries as economic realities and human experience of those realities strayed further and further from each other. In primitive societies, he notes, the division of labor was as yet undeveloped for the most part, requiring each person, family, or tribe to be relatively independent when it came to meeting their own basic material needs. Men built their own dwellings, farmed their own land, tended to their own livestock. This is not to deny that basic forms of trade took place, but, for the most part, our primitive ancestors lived fairly self-reliant, if crushingly poor, lives.
passages.zh: 托克维尔追踪了人类从原始社会到现代社会的经济发展，观察到一个历经数百年逐渐展开的悖论：经济现实与人类对这些现实的体验彼此越来越脱节。他指出，在原始社会中，劳动分工在很大程度上尚未发展起来，因此每个人、每个家庭或部落在满足自身基本物质需求时，都必须相对独立。人们建造自己的住所，耕种自己的土地，照料自己的牲畜。这并不是说当时不存在基本形式的贸易，但总的来说，我们的原始祖先过着相当自给自足、却极其贫困的生活。

passages.en: F) However, the exclusively local and face-to-face nature of economic and political organization in the ancient and prehistoric worlds constantly impressed upon these primitive peoples the uncontrollable reality of others and their needs. As Tocqueville notes, "as soon as a man begins to deal with common affairs in public, he begins to perceive that he is not so independent of his fellow men as he had first imagined, and that in order to obtain their support he must often lend them his cooperation."
passages.zh: 然而，古代和史前世界中经济与政治组织完全局限于地方且以面对面交往为基础的性质，不断使这些原始民族意识到他人及其需求这一无法控制的现实。正如托克维尔所指出的：“一个人一旦开始在公共场合处理共同事务，就开始意识到，自己并不像起初想象的那样独立于同胞；为了获得他们的支持，他往往必须向他们提供合作。”

passages.en: G) At the advent of the modern world, the division of labor spread further and further throughout society. Each person became more and more dependent on others for their basic needs. And yet, robbed of the engagement with our neighbors and with our local communities that our ancestors were forced into by circumstance, we feel ourselves to be more and more independent of one another. As we become more and more dependent on others, we become less and less conscious of our dependence on others. This is the paradox of trade in the modern world.
passages.zh: 现代世界来临之际，劳动分工在整个社会中不断扩展。每个人在基本需求方面越来越依赖他人。然而，由于我们的祖先迫于环境而不得不与邻居和当地社区交往，而我们失去了这种交往，我们反而觉得彼此越来越独立。我们越是依赖他人，就越没有意识到自己对他人的依赖。这就是现代世界的贸易悖论。

passages.en: H) The false consciousness that this paradox generates causes havoc on the debates we have about free trade. There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe. But as Tocqueville already foresaw in 1840, we do not feel dependent on these strangers for our way of life. No sense of the dependence of our own material welfare on their work ever strikes our national consciousness. We rarely contemplate the globalized avenues of free trade with gratitude.
passages.zh: 这一悖论所产生的虚假意识，给我们围绕自由贸易展开的辩论造成了混乱。美国任何一个家庭中的商品，几乎没有哪一种不是通过某条供应链，依靠分布在全球各地的几十个不同的人来完成生产和销售的。但正如托克维尔早在1840年就预见到的那样，我们并不觉得自己的生活方式依赖于这些陌生人。我们本国的物质福祉依赖于他们的劳动，这一意识从未真正进入我们的国民意识。我们很少怀着感激之情思考全球化的自由贸易渠道。

passages.en: I) There are two reasons for this. The first, to put it bluntly, is money. Money allows us to purchase the work of others without giving any thought to them as human beings. Unlike our ancestors in their primitive townships, we rarely have to meet face-to-face the people who've invented, built, shipped, or supplied our goods. No relationship has to be built before an exchange can take place. Simply agree on a price, and you can have any goods you wish without taking a second thought for the human being involved on the other side of the transaction. In this way, money makes us feel more independent than we actually are. Each of us senses the hold that it has over our fellows. We know that if we bid highly enough we can buy ourselves out of the time-consuming labor of building relationships. Money is kind of like magic in that way. It gives us a set of rituals to perform and promises that if we do so we'll be able to wield power over others. The illusion is created that having enough money to buy something is the equivalent of knowing how to make it yourself. Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness.
passages.zh: 这有两个原因。说得直白一点，第一个原因是金钱。金钱使我们能够购买他人的劳动，而无需想到他们也是有血有肉的人。与生活在原始城镇中的祖先不同，我们很少需要与那些发明、制造、运输或供应商品的人面对面接触。交换发生之前无需建立任何关系。只要商定价格，你就可以得到自己想要的任何商品，而无需再考虑交易另一方所涉及的那个具体的人。这样一来，金钱让我们觉得自己比实际情况更加独立。我们每个人都能感受到金钱对同胞的支配力。我们知道，只要出价足够高，就能免去建立关系这一耗时的劳动。金钱在这方面有点像魔法。它提供一套供我们执行的仪式，并承诺只要照做，我们就能对他人施加力量。于是便产生了一种幻觉：拥有足够的钱去购买某种东西，就等同于知道如何亲手制造它。对于组成供应链的那些匿名男女的感激，很少进入我们的意识。

passages.en: J) Anonymity, in fact, is the second root cause of the free-trade paradox. Modernity has emancipated everyone from the limits of location and community. By and large, when we trade, we trade with strangers; when we vote, we vote for strangers; when we watch, read, or listen to stories, the tellers of the tales are strangers. As opposed to the ancestors Tocqueville compares us to, we do not know the people with whom we have to do, in either the economic or the political sphere. This is simply the shadow side of the miracle of markets, which, for the first time in history, have allowed strangers to look after each other. They've also allowed each of us to live more and more of our lives exclusively as strangers to other people. This is how Tocqueville—rather pessimistically—describes us: Each, standing apart, is like a stranger to the destiny of others; his children and personal friends forming for him the entire human race. As for the remainder of his fellow citizens, he is beside them, but he does not see them. He touches them, but he does not feel them. He exists only in and for himself.
passages.zh: 事实上，匿名性是自由贸易悖论的第二个根源。现代性使每个人都摆脱了地点和社区的限制。总的来说，我们进行贸易时，是在与陌生人交易；我们投票时，是在为陌生人投票；我们观看、阅读或聆听故事时，讲故事的人也是陌生人。与托克维尔拿来与我们比较的祖先不同，无论在经济领域还是政治领域，我们都不认识那些与我们发生关系的人。这只是市场奇迹的阴暗面。市场在历史上第一次让陌生人能够彼此照料，但也让我们每个人越来越多地以完全陌生人的身份生活于他人之中。托克维尔以一种相当悲观的方式这样描述我们：“每个人都与世隔绝，仿佛对他人的命运一无关系；他的子女和私人朋友构成了他的整个人类。至于其余的同胞，他与他们并肩而立，却看不见他们。他接触他们，却感受不到他们。他只存在于自己之中，也只为自己而存在。”

passages.en: K) The last sentence but one is as apt a summary as one could hope to come by of how each of us functions in the modern economy: "He touches them, but he does not feel them."
passages.zh: 倒数第二句堪称我们每个人在现代经济中运作方式的最佳概括：“他接触他们，却感受不到他们。”

passages.en: L) This is the greatest challenge facing defenders of free trade. It's exceedingly difficult for human beings to feel gratitude toward strangers, and the global marketplace that has made us so rich has also made us strangers to one another. Our brains are hardwired for tribal life, and tribes do not take kindly to strangers. Impressing a sense of dependence upon and gratitude toward foreign strangers is therefore an uphill task.
passages.zh: 这是自由贸易捍卫者面临的最大挑战。人类极难对陌生人产生感激之情，而使我们变得如此富裕的全球市场也使我们彼此成为陌生人。我们的大脑天生适应部落生活，而部落并不欢迎陌生人。因此，要让人们对外国陌生人产生依赖感和感激之情，是一项艰巨的任务。

passages.en: M) If free-traders are going to win policy arguments in the future, they'll have to find a way of forging bonds of affection between American consumers and foreign producers. Only by de-anonymizing the men and women who supply us with the goods and services we enjoy from overseas and by creating a sense of solidarity and relationship across borders that transcends economic interest can free trade win the day. Otherwise, the inborn biological upper hand that protectionists have in the form of nationalist solidarity is bound to win the day at the ballot box.
passages.zh: 如果自由贸易主义者未来要在政策争论中获胜，就必须找到一种方式，在美国消费者与外国生产者之间建立感情纽带。只有通过消除为我们提供海外商品和服务的男女的匿名性，并在跨越国界的范围内营造一种超越经济利益的团结感和关系感，自由贸易才能赢得最终胜利。否则，保护主义者与生俱来的生物学优势，也就是民族主义团结所赋予的优势，注定会在投票箱前赢得胜利。

statements.en: People became more and more reliant on others for basic needs as they entered the modern world even though they might feel less so.
statements.zh: 尽管人们可能感觉不那么依赖他人,但随着进入现代社会,他们在基本需求方面越来越依赖他人。

analysis.锚点: 现代世界中越依赖越不自知
analysis.定位: G 段 Each person became more and more dependent on others for their basic needs. And yet, robbed of the engagement with our neighbors and with our local communities that our ancestors were forced into by circumstance, we feel ourselves to be more and more independent of one another. As we become more and more dependent on others, we become less and less conscious of our dependence on others. This is the paradox of trade in the modern world. 每个人对他人满足自己基本需求的依赖越来越深。然而，我们被剥夺了先祖因环境所迫而与邻里和本地社区的日常往来，反而觉得自己越来越独立。我们对他人越发依赖，却越发意识不到这种依赖。这就是现代世界贸易的悖论。
analysis.改写: reliant on others for basic needs as they entered the modern world↔Each person became more and more dependent on others for their basic needs 同义词替换 even though they might feel less so↔we become less and less conscious of our dependence on others 感觉与意识的同义替换

passages.en: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant. Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning. There's just one problem: That's not how brains work.
passages.zh: 网上有数百种性格测试，声称能够判断你是大脑左半球还是右半球占主导。据说左脑型的人具有逻辑性，擅长语言和数学；而右脑型的人更富有想象力，情商更高，也更擅长空间推理。问题只有一个：大脑并不是这样运作的。

passages.en: Popular science enthusiasts sort of took this idea and ran with it, and it's become woven in popular culture now, and it's not going away.
passages.zh: 科普爱好者可以说是抓住了这个观点大肆发挥，如今它已经融入流行文化，而且不会消失。

passages.en: Despite this enduring belief, there's no such thing as being "right-brained" or "left-brained". Whether you're someone who tends more towards creativity or logic has nothing to do with one hemisphere of your brain being dominant over the other. But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction.
passages.zh: 尽管这种观念一直存在，但根本不存在所谓“右脑型”或“左脑型”的人。一个人更偏向创造性还是逻辑性，与其大脑的某个半球是否凌驾于另一个半球之上毫无关系。不过，我们大脑的两个半球如何协同工作，其真实科学原理有时比虚构作品还要奇特。

passages.en: The human brain is divided into two hemispheres, the left and right. In all vertebrate(脊椎的) animals, the right hemisphere controls the left side of the body and vice versa. And scientists have long known, thanks to the behaviors of patients who suffered brain injuries, that different areas of the brain do different things.
passages.zh: 人类大脑分为左、右两个半球。在所有脊椎动物中，右半球控制身体的左侧，反之亦然。科学家还早已通过那些遭受脑损伤的患者的行为了解到，大脑的不同区域承担着不同的功能。

passages.en: But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry.
passages.zh: 但是，许多科学家难以接受这一观点，因为仅仅是暗示大脑的左右两半运作方式不同，就冲击了自然趋向完美对称这一观念。

passages.en: Work by neuroscientists(神经科学家) has revealed the importance of different hemispheres of the brain for different activities. However, their research quickly saw some misinterpretations in the general public: Some presumed creative people must be right-brained and logical people left-brained. It is proven that not only is personality unrelated to the different halves of the brain, but people aren't really right- or left-brained to begin with. The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have.
passages.zh: 神经科学家的研究揭示了大脑不同半球对于不同活动的重要性。然而，他们的研究很快在公众中引发了一些误解：有些人想当然地认为，富有创造力的人一定是右脑型，而有逻辑性的人则是左脑型。事实证明，性格不仅与大脑的不同半球无关，而且人们从一开始就并不真正属于右脑型或左脑型。认为人群中存在左脑占主导者和右脑占主导者，并且这与性格有关，这种说法完全错误。神经科学界从未支持过这一观点。神经科学家不相信这一点，也从来没有相信过。

passages.en: What scientists learned is that there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere. It's just that they have nothing to do with personality or whether cognitive strategy is more logical or free spirited or creative. While researchers have shown the limitations of how the hemispheres of our brains influence our lives, it's not difficult to understand the appeal of such ideas. People are endlessly fascinated by themselves and their friends, and the subtle differences in how people think about the world are really meaningful to them. When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. It's irresistible. But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt.
passages.zh: 科学家了解到，左右两个大脑半球之间确实存在非常重要的差异。只是这些差异与性格无关，也与一个人的认知策略究竟更具逻辑性、更自由奔放还是更有创造力无关。尽管研究人员已经揭示了大脑半球对我们生活影响的局限性，但这类观点的吸引力并不难理解。人们始终对自己和朋友着迷，而人们思考世界的方式存在的细微差异，对他们而言确实意义重大。当你设计一个在线测试，告诉我们一些关于自己的事情时，我们就会被它吸引。这种诱惑难以抗拒。但你必须对它持极大的保留态度。

questions.stem: What do numerous personality quizzes online claim they are able to do?
questions.stem_zh: 众多在线性格测试声称它们能够做什么?

options.text: Distinguish between the two hemispheres of one's brain.
options.zh: 区分一个人大脑的两个半球。

options.text: Determine whether one is left-brained or right-brained.
options.zh: 判断一个人是左脑型还是右脑型。

options.text: Tell if one is more of a linguist or of a mathematician.
options.zh: 判断一个人更像语言学家还是数学家。

options.text: Ascertain how one's brain performs different tasks.
options.zh: 确定一个人的大脑如何执行不同任务。

questions.判型: What do numerous personality quizzes online claim they are able to do? 是 What 引导的事实性提问，问"quizzes 声称做什么"，可直接回原文找事实陈述。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What do…quizzes…claim they are able to do?，What 作 do 的宾语，they are able to do 是 claim 的宾语从句；结构平铺，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant. 网络上有成百上千的性格测试，宣称它们能够查明你的左半脑还是右半脑占主导。

locate.en: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant.
locate.zh: 网络上有成百上千的性格测试，宣称它们能够查明你的左半脑还是右半脑占主导。

option_analysis.note: Distinguish between the two hemispheres of one's brain 说的是"区分大脑的两个半球"——这是解剖事实而非测试声称的本事，与原文承诺的"判断哪边占主导"不同。
B 项把定位句改写成"判断一个人是左脑型还是右脑型"，与预判一致，且严格落在 P1 首句的字面承诺范围内。

pairs.orig: ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant
pairs.opt: Determine whether one is left-brained or right-brained

option_analysis.note: Tell if one is more of a linguist or of a mathematician 取自 excel at language and math 的延伸描述，是"左脑型人"的衍生特征，而非测试本身宣称要做的事。
Ascertain how one's brain performs different tasks 的内容来自 different areas of the brain do different things，那是科学界的事实，不是"测试"声称要做的；动词 Ascertain 虽与原文同词，但宾语错配。

questions.stem: What does the author say is sometimes stranger than fiction?
questions.stem_zh: 作者说什么有时比小说更离奇?

options.text: How one hemisphere of the brain impacts creativity.
options.zh: 大脑的一个半球如何影响创造力。

options.text: How the two halves of our brains work alternately.
options.zh: 我们大脑的两半如何交替工作。

options.text: How the two hemispheres of our brains cooperate.
options.zh: 我们大脑的两个半球如何合作。

options.text: How one half of the brain dominates the other.
options.zh: 大脑的一半如何主导另一半。

questions.判型: What does the author say is sometimes stranger than fiction? 问作者明说的内容，是对原文一句话的事实复现。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What does the author say is…?，What 是表语补足语，is sometimes stranger than fiction 修饰 What 指向的具体事物；结构简单。
questions.定位: P3 But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction. 但关于我们大脑两个半球如何协同运作的真实科学，有时比小说还要离奇。

locate.en: But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction.
locate.zh: 但关于我们大脑两个半球如何协同运作的真实科学，有时比小说还要离奇。

option_analysis.note: How one hemisphere of the brain impacts creativity 关注"某一个半脑对创造力的影响"，定位句强调的是"两半协同"，主体数量不符；creativity 也是从前文带过来的旁支话题。
How the two halves of our brains work alternately 把 work together 改成 work alternately（轮流工作），意思完全不同——一个是同时合作，一个是交替使用。
C 项把 "halves…work together" 替换成 "hemispheres…cooperate"，是定位句的等值改写。

pairs.orig: the two halves of our brains work together
pairs.opt: the two hemispheres of our brains cooperate

option_analysis.note: How one half of the brain dominates the other 正是文章一开头就否定的"左右脑主导说"，与定位句乃至全文立场相反。

questions.stem: Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea that different areas of the brain do different things?
questions.stem_zh: 为什么许多科学家难以认可大脑不同区域做不同事情这一观点?

options.text: It contradicts the assumption that the two hemispheres of the brain are symmetrical.
options.zh: 它与大脑两个半球对称的假设相矛盾。

options.text: It dismisses the view that the universe has been evolving in a consistent manner.
options.zh: 它否定了宇宙一直以一致方式演化的观点。

options.text: It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together.
options.zh: 它与大脑左右两半共同工作的说法相冲突。

options.text: It disrupts the idea that the right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body.
options.zh: 它打破了大脑右半球控制身体左侧的观点。

questions.判型: Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea…? 问原因，且原因通常在原文同句以 because/since 给出。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea…?，that different areas of the brain do different things 是 idea 的同位语从句，解释 idea 内容；理解关键是 endorsing="赞同/接受"，不是"支持"商业意味。
questions.定位: P5 But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry. 但许多科学家难以接受这个观点，因为"大脑左右半球运作方式不同"这一论断本身就动摇了"自然界趋向完美对称"的观念。

locate.en: But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry.
locate.zh: 但许多科学家难以接受这个观点，因为"大脑左右半球运作方式不同"这一论断本身就动摇了"自然界趋向完美对称"的观念。

option_analysis.note: A 项把"动摇自然对称预设"这一动作改写为"与左右脑对称的预设相矛盾"，二者在本语境下指代同一观念，定位句即等于 A 项。

pairs.orig: disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry
pairs.opt: contradicts the assumption that the two hemispheres of the brain are symmetrical

option_analysis.note: It dismisses the view that the universe has been evolving in a consistent manner 把对象从"自然对称"扩展为"宇宙演化方式"，原文未涉及宇宙演化的话题。
It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together 把矛盾对象说成"两半脑协同"，但原文中科学家排斥的不是"协同"，而是"对称"预设；况且"协同"是 P3 的肯定观点，本身不会被科学家抗拒。
It disrupts the idea that the right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body 取自 P4 的解剖事实，是脊椎动物的客观规律，不可能被科学家抗拒；动词 disrupts 虽与原文同词，宾语却换错。

questions.stem: What belief have neuroscientists long rejected according to the passage?
questions.stem_zh: 根据文章,神经科学家长期以来拒绝接受什么观点?

options.text: There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities.
options.zh: 存在具有不同性格的左脑主导型和右脑主导型的人。

options.text: There are noticeable differences between the left and right hemispheres of the brain.
options.zh: 大脑左右半球之间存在明显差异。

options.text: One's personality is hardly related to the different halves of the brain.
options.zh: 一个人的性格与大脑的不同半球几乎无关。

options.text: Different areas of the brain are responsible for different activities.
options.zh: 大脑的不同区域负责不同的活动。

questions.判型: What belief have neuroscientists long rejected according to the passage? 问"哪个观念被拒"，是对原文一处明确表态的复现。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What belief have neuroscientists long rejected…?，long 修饰 rejected 表"长久以来一直拒绝"；现在完成时 + long，强调持续否定，是定位句的语气信号。
questions.定位: P6 The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have. "存在左脑主导型人和右脑主导型人、并且这与人格有关"这一观念是完全错误的。神经科学界从未支持过这种说法。神经科学家不相信这种说法，也从未相信过。

locate.en: The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have.
locate.zh: "存在左脑主导型人和右脑主导型人、并且这与人格有关"这一观念是完全错误的。神经科学界从未支持过这种说法。神经科学家不相信这种说法，也从未相信过。

option_analysis.note: A 项就是定位句被 categorically false / never been supported 否定的那个具体观念，与预判一致。

pairs.orig: we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality
pairs.opt: There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities

option_analysis.note: There are noticeable differences between the left and right hemispheres of the brain 是 there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere 明确肯定的事实，神经科学界并不拒斥它。
One's personality is hardly related to the different halves of the brain 正是作者本人和神经科学界所持的立场（人格与左右脑无关），不是他们"长期拒绝"的观念。
Different areas of the brain are responsible for different activities 是 different areas of the brain do different things 的同义改写，是科学界共识，不可能被"长期拒绝"。

questions.stem: What are we advised to do with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves?
questions.stem_zh: 对于告诉我们一些关于自己信息的在线测试,我们被建议做什么?

options.text: Challenge its authority.
options.zh: 质疑其权威性。

options.text: Scrutinize its originality.
options.zh: 审查其原创性。

options.text: Evaluate its popularity.
options.zh: 评估其受欢迎程度。

options.text: Question its reliability.
options.zh: 质疑其可靠性。

questions.判型: What are we advised to do…? 问作者给出的具体建议，原文末段必有对应明示。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What are we advised to do with an online quiz…?，that tells us something about ourselves 是 quiz 的定语从句；advise sb. to do 的被动 are advised to do 是常见结构，注意 with 引出对象 "对……怎么办"。
questions.定位: P7 When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. It's irresistible. But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt. 当出现一份告诉我们自身某些情况的网络测试时，我们会被吸引，难以抗拒。但你必须对它持极大的保留态度。

locate.en: When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. It's irresistible. But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt.
locate.zh: 当出现一份告诉我们自身某些情况的网络测试时，我们会被吸引，难以抗拒。但你必须对它持极大的保留态度。

option_analysis.note: Challenge its authority 暗示要去"挑战其权威性"，但原文只是建议保留态度、不轻信结论，并未要求与之对抗。
Scrutinize its originality 让人去审查"原创性"，原文丝毫未涉及测试是否原创的问题。
Evaluate its popularity 评的是"测试的流行程度"，与作者给读者的"个人如何对待结论"的建议完全错位。
把习语 take it with an enormous grain of salt 还原为字面意 question its reliability，与预判一致。

pairs.orig: take it with an enormous grain of salt

passages.en: One hundred thirty-five students, four teachers, one giant classroom: This is what 9th grade looks like at Westwood High School, in Mesa, Arizona's largest school system. There, an innovative teaching model has taken hold, and is spreading to other schools in the district and beyond.
passages.zh: 135名学生、4名教师、1间巨大的教室：这就是亚利桑那州梅萨市最大学区的韦斯特伍德高中九年级的样子。在那里，一种创新的教学模式已经扎根，并正在向该学区内外的其他学校推广。

passages.en: Five years ago, faced with high teacher turnover and declining student enrollment, Westwood's leaders decided to try something different. Working with professors at Arizona State University's teachers college, they piloted a classroom model known as team teaching, which allows teachers to dissolve the walls that separate their classes across physical or grade divides.
passages.zh: 五年前，面对教师流动率高和学生入学人数下降的问题，韦斯特伍德高中的领导者决定尝试一些不同的做法。他们与亚利桑那州立大学教师学院的教授合作，试行了一种称为团队教学的课堂模式。这种模式允许教师打破因实体空间或年级划分而将各自班级分隔开的界限。

passages.en: The teachers share large groups of students—sometimes 100 or more—and rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups, or whatever the teachers as a team agree is a priority that day. What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day.
passages.zh: 教师们共同负责大批学生，有时人数达到100名或更多，并在集体授课、一对一辅导、小组学习以及教师团队共同认定的当天优先事项之间轮换。课堂有时看起来像是一片混乱，实际上却是一项经过精心统筹的计划：每天早晨，韦斯特伍德的教师团队都会开会，为当天团队将重点关注的每一名学生制定个性化方案。

passages.en: By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate, Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention. Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off.
passages.zh: 梅萨市的管理者希望，通过给教师提供更多合作机会，可以填补人员空缺，并提升教师的士气和留任率。初步研究表明，这场冒险可能会取得成功。

passages.en: "Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it's very rare a teacher walks into another room to see what's happening," said Andi Fourlis, superintendent of Mesa Public Schools. "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation."
passages.zh: 梅萨公立学校学区负责人安迪·福利斯说：“教师们正在做着非常出色的事情，但教师走进另一个教室去看看那里发生了什么，这种情况非常少见。我们的职业进步如此缓慢，是因为我们一直在孤立地工作。”

passages.en: Of course, overhauling teaching approaches can't fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay, but early results from Mesa show team teaching may be helping to reverse low morale. In a survey of hundreds of the district's teachers, researchers found those who worked on teams reported greater job satisfaction, more frequent collaborations with colleagues, and more positive interactions with students.
passages.zh: 当然，彻底改革教学方式无法解决教师面临的所有挫折，例如薪资偏低，但梅萨市的早期结果显示，团队教学或许正在帮助扭转低落的士气。在对该学区数百名教师进行的一项调查中，研究人员发现，参与团队教学的教师表示他们对工作的满意度更高，与同事合作的频率更高，与学生的互动也更加积极。

passages.en: Another benefit of teams, teachers say, is that they can help each other improve their instruction. During one planning session, English teacher Jeff Hall shared a performance appraisal with a science teacher: Her recent lecture on something she called "the central dogma of biology" had bewildered him and their other teammates.
passages.zh: 教师们说，团队教学的另一项好处是，他们可以互相帮助改进教学。在一次备课会议上，英语教师杰夫·霍尔与一位科学教师分享了一份教学表现评价：那位教师最近讲授的、她称为“生物学中心法则”的内容，让他和团队中的其他教师都感到困惑。

passages.en: "If the science is too confusing for me, can you imagine the frustration you feel as kids?" Hall said. But the science teacher, he said, wouldn't have known about the confusion on her own.
passages.zh: 霍尔说：“如果连我都觉得科学内容太令人困惑，你能想象作为学生会感到多么沮丧吗？”不过，他说，那位科学教师如果独自授课，本来不会知道大家对此感到困惑。

passages.en: The model is not for everyone. Some teachers approached about volunteering for a team have said they prefer to work alone. Team teaching can also be a scheduling nightmare, especially at schools like Westwood where only some staff work in teams. There are also thorny questions like how to evaluate four teachers on the performance of 135 students. But for the time being, it seems to be working.
passages.zh: 这种模式并不适合所有人。一些被邀请自愿参加团队教学的教师表示，他们更愿意独自工作。团队教学也可能让排课变成一场噩梦，尤其是在韦斯特伍德高中这样只有部分教职员工参与团队教学的学校。此外，还存在一些棘手的问题，例如如何根据135名学生的表现来评价4名教师。但就目前而言，这种模式似乎正在发挥作用。

questions.stem: What do we learn about team teaching from the passage?
questions.stem_zh: 从文章中我们对团队教学了解到什么?

options.text: It is generally conducted in classrooms without walls.
options.zh: 它通常在没有墙壁的教室中进行。

options.text: It allows students to choose teachers they favor most.
options.zh: 它允许学生选择他们最喜欢的教师。

options.text: It prioritizes peer work over classroom instruction.
options.zh: 它优先考虑同伴学习而非课堂教学。

options.zh: 尽管看似混乱,但它是密切协调的。

questions.判型: 题干 What do we learn about team teaching from the passage? 不含 infer/imply/main idea，问的是对 team teaching 的客观描述，属概括式细节。
questions.拆句: What do we learn about team teaching from the passage? 主干为 What...do we learn，about team teaching 修饰 learn 的对象，from the passage 是来源状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P3 What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day. 看上去时不时像一团乱麻的场面，实际上是经过精心编排的方案：每天清晨，Westwood 的团队会碰头，为当天他们要重点关注的每个学生敲定一份个性化方案。

locate.en: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day.
locate.zh: 看上去时不时像一团乱麻的场面，实际上是经过精心编排的方案：每天清晨，Westwood 的团队会碰头，为当天他们要重点关注的每个学生敲定一份个性化方案。

translation.title: 2024年12月·第3套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 中国航天成就发展史介绍 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想。2003年,神舟五号飞船发射成功,杨利伟成为第一个飞入太空的中国宇航员。2008年,神舟七号升空,翟志刚成为中国历史上首位进行太空行走的宇航员。近年来,中国航天进入创新发展"快车道",太空基础设施建设稳步推进,中国空间站于2022年全面建成。中国航天事业的迅速发展在中华民族的历史上写下了辉煌一页,也为人类文明进步做出了巨大贡献。未来,中国探索太空的脚步将迈得更稳、更远。
translation.reference_en:
Exploring space has always been a dream of the Chinese nation. In 2003, Shenzhou-5 was successfully launched, and Yang Liwei became the first Chinese astronaut to fly into space. In 2008, Shenzhou-7 was launched, and Zhai Zhigang became the first astronaut to conduct a spacewalk in China's history. In recent years, China's space industry has entered a fast track of innovation-driven development, space infrastructure has advanced steadily, and China's space station was fully completed in 2022. The rapid development of China's space industry has written a glorious chapter in the history of the Chinese nation and made a great contribution to the progress of human civilization. In the future, China will take steadier and further steps in its exploration of space.
【衔接】
第2、3句之间补时间顺承第2句 In 2003 与第3句 In 2008 都以年份开头，本身已构成清晰的时间顺承，读起来自然连贯，无需额外补连接词；只要保证两句句式平行（都是 In + 年份, 飞船 was launched, and 某人 became...），整篇叙事节奏就立住了。
第4句前补承接显近况转折第3句讲 2008 年，第4句 近年来 跳到近况，时间发生跨越。译文用 In recent years 开头已自然承接；若想让"梦想—早期突破—近年加速"的递进更明显，可在 In recent years 后顺势叙述，无须额外关联词，时间状语本身就是最好的衔接。
第5句用 development 回指上文成就第5句 中国航天事业的迅速发展 是对前面 2003、2008、近年三段成就的总括。译文用 The rapid development of China's space industry 作主语，自然把上文具体事件收束成一个抽象总结，起到承上启下的衔接作用，不必再加 In short 之类的词。
末句用 In the future 收束全篇第6句 未来 译成 In the future 置于句首，与开篇 has always been a dream 的"梦想"遥相呼应，把全篇从"过去—现在"自然引向"未来"，形成首尾呼应的完整结构，是一个有力的收尾。

cohesion.detail: 第2句 In 2003 与第3句 In 2008 都以年份开头，本身已构成清晰的时间顺承，读起来自然连贯，无需额外补连接词；只要保证两句句式平行（都是 In + 年份, 飞船 was launched, and 某人 became...），整篇叙事节奏就立住了。

cohesion.core: 第4句前补承接显近况转折
cohesion.detail: 第3句讲 2008 年，第4句 近年来 跳到近况，时间发生跨越。译文用 In recent years 开头已自然承接；若想让"梦想—早期突破—近年加速"的递进更明显，可在 In recent years 后顺势叙述，无须额外关联词，时间状语本身就是最好的衔接。

cohesion.core: 第5句用 development 回指上文成就
cohesion.detail: 第5句 中国航天事业的迅速发展 是对前面 2003、2008、近年三段成就的总括。译文用 The rapid development of China's space industry 作主语，自然把上文具体事件收束成一个抽象总结，起到承上启下的衔接作用，不必再加 In short 之类的词。

cohesion.core: 末句用 In the future 收束全篇
cohesion.detail: 第6句 未来 译成 In the future 置于句首，与开篇 has always been a dream 的"梦想"遥相呼应，把全篇从"过去—现在"自然引向"未来"，形成首尾呼应的完整结构，是一个有力的收尾。

main_idea.core: 中国航天成就发展史介绍
main_idea.detail: 全段是一篇典型的六级"中国成就介绍"，按时间线铺陈中国载人航天与空间站的标志性事件。开篇 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想 先点明这是一个由来已久的梦想，随后用 2003年、2008年、近年来、未来 一路把过去成就讲到将来展望。语体是客观、略带自豪色彩的事实陈述，用词宜正式、平实，不要口语化。

tense.detail: 全篇骨干是已经发生的航天成就史，多数句子叙述确切年份里完成的事件，如 2003年,神舟五号飞船发射成功 与 2008年,神舟七号升空，这些都用一般过去时。故定一般过去时为基调；仅在三处偏离：首句 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想 讲恒常事实用一般现在时，中国空间站于2022年全面建成 这种"已完成并持续到现在"可用现在完成时，末句 未来,中国探索太空的脚步将迈得更稳、更远 展望未来用一般将来时。

term_notes.core: 神舟五号 / 神舟七号
term_notes.detail: 神舟五号 与 神舟七号 是飞船的专名，约定俗成的官方译法为音译加序数：Shenzhou-5 与 Shenzhou-7（也可写 Shenzhou V / VII）。取法依据是音译专名 + 阿拉伯序号，全篇统一用连字符式 Shenzhou-5、Shenzhou-7。
人名 杨利伟 用汉语拼音音译 Yang Liwei，姓在前、名在后、首字母大写。这是中国人名约定俗成的拼音译法。
人名 翟志刚 同样用汉语拼音 Zhai Zhigang，姓 Zhai 在前。注意 Zhi、gang 拼写不要写错。
中国空间站 意译为 China's space station（或 the Chinese space station）。这是普通名词性的设施名，意译即可，不必音译；全篇统一用 China's space station。
中华民族 译为 the Chinese nation，指作为整体的中华民族；不要误译成 Chinese people（人民）或 nationality（国籍）。全篇统一用 the Chinese nation。

steps.text: 梦想是主语、太空遨游是表语核心（主语策略：原句主语）中文里 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想 的核心是"……是……的梦想"这一判断句。可把"遨游太空"提为主语（动名词 Travelling/Exploring space），"是中华民族的梦想"作系表：Exploring space has always been a dream of the Chinese nation。主谓宾即 Exploring space (主) — has been (系) — a dream (表)。
历来用 always 状语处理本句结构简单，主干之外只有 历来 这个时间副词，降级成状语 always，放在 has 与 been 之间：has always been。"中华民族的"作定语，用 of the Chinese nation 后置修饰 dream，不必前置成 the Chinese nation's。
时态此句讲"历来、一直如此"的恒常状态，是少数偏离过去时基调的句子，宜用现在完成时 has always been，强调从过去延续至今的持续状态。 主谓一致主语是动名词短语 Exploring space，视作单数第三人称，助动词用 has 而非 have。 冠词"一个梦想"是泛指可数单数，用不定冠词 a dream；the Chinese nation 是特指整体，用定冠词 the。
Exploring space has always been a dream of the Chinese nation.
拆成两个主干分别立（主语策略：原句主语）神舟五号飞船发射成功,杨利伟成为第一个飞入太空的中国宇航员 含两件事，可立两个主干。第一件"飞船发射成功"可用被动 Shenzhou-5 was successfully launched（飞船是被发射的）；第二件"杨利伟成为……宇航员"用 Yang Liwei became... 主系表式。两个主干用逗号 + and 或分号连接。
时间状语前置加后置定语2003年 降级成时间状语 In 2003 置于句首。第一个飞入太空的中国宇航员 里"飞入太空的"是修饰"宇航员"的成分，降级成后置定语：the first Chinese astronaut to fly into space（用不定式 to fly 作后置定语）。"发射成功"的"成功"降级成副词 successfully。

时态2003 年是确切的过去时间点，回指全篇基调用一般过去时：was launched、became。 语态"飞船发射成功"中飞船是被发射的对象，英文用被动 was launched 更自然；汉语常省略被动标记，译时要主动补上被动。 单复数与冠词"第一个……宇航员"特指唯一一人，用 the first Chinese astronaut，单数加定冠词 the。 搭配"飞入太空"用 fly into space；"成为……宇航员"用 became the first... astronaut，become 后接名词作表语。
In 2003, Shenzhou-5 was successfully launched, and Yang Liwei became the first Chinese astronaut to fly into space.
与第2句同构的双主干（主语策略：原句主语）结构与上一句平行：神舟七号升空 立一个主干 Shenzhou-7 was launched（或 lifted off）；翟志刚成为中国历史上首位进行太空行走的宇航员 立第二个主干 Zhai Zhigang became the first astronaut...。两主干并列。
进行太空行走作后置定语2008年 降级为句首状语 In 2008。首位进行太空行走的宇航员 中"进行太空行走的"修饰"宇航员"，降级成后置定语：the first astronaut to conduct a spacewalk（或 to carry out a spacewalk）。中国历史上 降级成状语 in China's history，置于句末。

时态2008 年是过去时间点，回指基调用一般过去时：was launched、became、conducted（若用定语从句）。 语态"升空"指飞船被发射升空，可用被动 was launched；若用 lifted off（升空，不及物）则主动即可——二者择一，注意 lift off 是不及物短语动词不可加被动。 单复数与冠词"首位……宇航员"特指唯一，the first astronaut 单数加 the；"一次太空行走"用 a spacewalk，泛指一次可数。 搭配"进行太空行走"用 conduct/carry out a spacewalk；spacewalk 是约定俗成的术语，比直译 walk in space 更地道。
In 2008, Shenzhou-7 was launched, and Zhai Zhigang became the first astronaut to conduct a spacewalk in China's history.

三件事三个主干并列（主语策略：原句主语）本句含三件事：中国航天进入创新发展"快车道"（China's space industry entered a fast track of innovation-driven development）、太空基础设施建设稳步推进（space infrastructure construction advanced steadily）、中国空间站于2022年全面建成（China's space station was fully completed in 2022）。每件事各立一套主谓，用分号或逗号 + and 并列。
末段建成事件用被动收尾近年来 降级为句首状语 In recent years。前两件事用主动并列；第三件 中国空间站于2022年全面建成 中空间站是被建成的，用被动 was fully completed，于2022年 作时间状语 in 2022 后置。"创新发展"作定语修饰"快车道"，用 a fast track of innovation-driven development。

时态"近年来"加确切的"2022年"，叙述近期已完成的进展，回指基调用一般过去时：entered、advanced、was completed。"近年来"若想强调延续到现在也可用现在完成时 has entered，但全句宜统一，建议跟基调用过去时。 语态"空间站全面建成"中空间站是被建成的对象，用被动 was fully completed；汉语省略了"被"，译时补出。 单复数与冠词a fast track 泛指一条快车道，用不定冠词 a；China's space station 用所有格特指中国的那座，不再加 the。 用词"快车道"是比喻，译 fast track 即可，引号在英文中可省；"稳步推进"用 advanced steadily 或 progressed steadily；"全面建成"用 fully completed。
In recent years, China's space industry has entered a fast track of innovation-driven development, space infrastructure has advanced steadily, and China's space station was fully completed in 2022.

迅速发展作主语带两个谓语（主语策略：原句主语）主语是 中国航天事业的迅速发展（The rapid development of China's space industry）。它带两个并列谓语：写下了辉煌一页（has written a glorious chapter）和 也为人类文明进步做出了巨大贡献（and made a great contribution）。主干为 The rapid development (主) — has written... and made... (并列谓语)。
处所与目的降为介词短语在中华民族的历史上 降级成介词短语 in the history of the Chinese nation 作状语；为人类文明进步 降级成介词短语 to the progress of human civilization 作 contribution 的搭配补足（make a contribution to...）。两个修饰都用介词短语后挂，主干保持清爽。

时态"写下了""做出了"是已完成且影响延续至今的成就，用现在完成时 has written、(has) made 最贴切；也可跟基调用一般过去时 wrote、made，二者择一并前后一致。 搭配"做出贡献"是固定搭配 make a contribution to sth，介词必须用 to；"写下辉煌一页"用 write a glorious chapter/page 的比喻表达。 主谓一致主语核心是 development（单数），谓语用 has；后一个并列谓语 made 与 has written 共用助动词 has，写成 has written... and made...。 单复数与冠词a glorious chapter 泛指辉煌的一页用 a；human civilization 抽象不可数，前面不加冠词。
The rapid development of China's space industry has written a glorious chapter in the history of the Chinese nation and made a great contribution to the progress of human civilization.
中国作主语谓语用将来时（主语策略：原句主语）中文字面主语是"脚步"，但直译 China's steps... 偏生硬。可把 中国 提为主语：China will take steadier and further steps in space exploration（中国将迈出更稳更远的步伐）。主干为 China (主) — will take (谓) — steps (宾)。
更稳更远降为形容词比较级未来 降级成句首状语 In the future。更稳、更远 是修饰"迈步"的程度，降级成形容词比较级 steadier and further 作 steps 的前置定语（take steadier and further steps）。探索太空的 用介词短语 in space exploration 后置说明领域。

时态"未来……将……"明确是对将来的展望，这是偏离基调的一句，用一般将来时 will take。 比较级"更稳"steady→steadier，"更远"far→further/farther，都要用比较级形式，不能用原级 steady、far。 单复数与搭配take steps 中 steps 习惯用复数；"探索太空"用 space exploration（不可数抽象名词，不加冠词）或 the exploration of space。
In the future, China will take steadier and further steps in its exploration of space.
